QuestInfo.name: Restoring the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture
QuestInfo.1: Alcaster said he's ready to restore the spirit statue, and gave you the Ice Crystal. He said the crystal was the key to fix the statue...
QuestInfo.2: Nyalmo seems to have returned to his gentle self as soon as the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture was restored. No worries about him attacking anyone else now.

0.0: Welcome. Yes, I've heard from Scadur. I've just now finished whipping up this ice crystal to restore the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture. Here's the crystal. Go find the sculpture and restore it to its original form. Once that's done, Nyalmo is sure to calm down.

no.0: I've heard you're doing a good job holding Nyalmo back, but that won't last forever. Restoring the sculpture is our only hope.

1.0: (As soon as the ice crystal is placed near the sculpture, the crystal sinks into the sculpture and the broken pieces are restored.)

yes.0: (Nyalmo's crying gradually subsides. The huge creature then leaves, fading away in the distant snow.)

npc.0: Go seek the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture with this ice crystal.

item.0: (It seems that a special item is needed to restore the Spirit of the Snow Sculpture.)

lost.0: You've lost the ice crystal. It is the only thing that can save El Nath. I can afford another spare to give to you, but please keep in mind that this is not easy to create. Please take care of it.
